name: Deleverage-rally fade (15m short the short-cover pop)
rationale: MECHANISM (H2 on a faster 15m bar): the participation-less pop mean-reverts quickly, so a 15m cadence fades it nearer the exhaustion of the covering flow. Price rises while OI falls = short-covers buying to close then ceasing; the counterparty is that self-extinguishing bid, and once it is gone the pop rolls over. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (contracting) AND ret_Nd above a positive floor over a short lookback (rising into the contraction) AND rsi above an overbought floor AND adx below a ceiling (reversion, not a real trend). DISCONFIRMER: swap OI-down for OI-UP — if it does not flip to a loser, the divergence is cosmetic and you are shorting RSI; and this must be time-disjoint from H1 (no shared profitable bars) or the OI-direction read is a coin-flip. Faster bar = more fee turns, so the fade must clear ~20bps net with margin.
catalyst: 15m OI contraction + fresh overbought pop, no trend — short-cover exhaustion
